reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis assumes that increasing spray distance to 300–350 mm will increase particle velocity, but in HVAF, velocity typically peaks at an optimal distance and then decreases due to cooling and drag; the cited MCrAlY study noted a slight gain in DE at higher velocity but did not establish that 300–350 mm is the velocity-maximizing distance for the i7 torch with this specific alloy and size range.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment is well-defined with clear, measurable outcomes (thickness, adhesion, porosity, oxide content) and a specific falsification criterion, though it lacks details on how the 120 mm internal diameter geometry will be accommodated in the test.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the thickness limitation with a simple, process-based intervention and builds on prior work, making it a practical and relevant starting point for experimental optimization.
